mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation acceleration (>0.3% YoY) and elevated FEDFUNDS (>4.0%) signal imminent monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions (GDPC1 growth < 0% YoY), a 3-month UNRATE increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals worsening economic conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month moving average signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals real economy contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through prolonged low discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window for 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous RSAFS decline (>1.0% YoY) and UNRATE increase (>0.2pp in 3 months) signal deepening economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 1.0% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where RSAFS falls > 1.0% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.
